name: Wilderness scorpions
accessNote: Wilderness scorpion spawns (near the Bandit Camp and south-east Wilderness) for Krystilia's task. Bring only risk-appropriate gear as PKers frequent the area. The Slayer task/Scorpions table (pageid 297991) lists the Scorpion Pit as multi-combat, cannonable and safespottable; a cannon finishes the task in under a minute.
